connect.title: Connect to VoiceStudio
connect.subtitle: This app drives VoiceStudio running on your own computer or server. Nothing is processed in the cloud.
connect.scan_help: On your computer, open VoiceStudio, click the Local pill in the footer and choose Network. Then scan the QR code shown there.
connect.api_key_help: Only needed when the server sets OMNIVOICE_API_KEY. The key is exchanged for a session and never stored.
connect.error_unreachable: Can't reach {{host}}. Make sure VoiceStudio is running, Network sharing is on, and this phone is on the same network or Tailscale.
connect.error_not_voicestudio: {{host}} answered, but it isn't a VoiceStudio server. Check the address and port.
connect.error_pin: The PIN was rejected. Sharing generates a new PIN each time it's turned on — scan the QR code again.
connect.error_api_key: The API key was rejected. Check the key set in OMNIVOICE_API_KEY on the server.
connect.error_session_expired: Your session expired. Enter the API key again to reconnect.
connect.error_insecure: Plain http:// is only allowed for addresses on your local network or Tailscale. Use https:// for other servers.
connect.error_invalid_url: That doesn't look like a server address. Example: http://192.168.1.20:3900
connect.error_qr: This QR code isn't a VoiceStudio sharing code.

speak.placeholder: Type what you want to hear…
speak.engine_unavailable: This engine is unavailable. Check its installation on your computer.
speak.engine_no_cloning: This engine cannot use reference audio. Choose an engine that supports voice cloning, or use the default voice.
speak.reference_required: Choose a saved voice to use this model. You can import one from Gallery.

voices.empty: No voices yet. Clone one from a short recording.
voices.consent_title: Only clone voices you have permission to use
voices.consent_body: Confirm that this is your voice, or that the speaker has agreed to it being cloned.

dub.runs_on_host: Dubbing runs on your computer. You can leave this screen; progress resumes when you return.
dub.language_unavailable: This language has no supported target code. Choose another target language.
dub.translation_setup: Choose, install, and configure a translation engine on your computer in VoiceStudio → Settings, then try again.
dub.translation_changed: The translation engine changed on your computer. Start this dub again to review the selected service.
dub.translation_online_title: Allow online translation for this dub?
dub.translation_online_body: Your computer will send this dub’s transcript to {{service}} for translation. Allow this only for this job?

dictate.not_ready: Dictation isn't ready on the server yet: {{reason}}
dictate.install_model: Install {{model}} on your computer in VoiceStudio → Settings → Models / Dictation, then retry.
dictate.setup: Dictation is not ready. On your computer, check VoiceStudio → Settings → Models / Dictation, then refresh.
dictate.authorization: Dictation requires authorization. Reconnect with your API key, or configure a trusted network on your computer; a sharing PIN alone does not authorize dictation.
dictate.install_model_size: Install {{model}} ({{size}} GB) on your computer in VoiceStudio → Settings → Models / Dictation, then retry.

settings.notifications_help: Notify when a dub finishes. Notifications are created on this phone; nothing goes through a cloud service.
settings.privacy_help: This app only talks to the VoiceStudio server you paired. No accounts, no cloud processing.

permissions.camera: VoiceStudio uses the camera only to scan the pairing QR code.
permissions.microphone: VoiceStudio uses the microphone to record voice samples and for dictation. Audio goes only to your paired server.
permissions.local_network: VoiceStudio connects to the VoiceStudio server on your local network.
permissions.denied: Permission denied. You can allow it in system Settings.

errors.offline: The server isn't reachable right now. Retrying…
errors.timeout: The server took too long to answer. It may be busy loading a model — try again in a moment.
errors.model_licence_required:
{{models}}
Accept it on your computer in VoiceStudio → Model Catalogue
errors.invalid_response: The server returned an unexpected response. Update VoiceStudio on the host and try again.
errors.forbidden: The host refused this action. Check permissions on your computer in VoiceStudio and reconnect.
errors.rate_limited: The host is busy or limiting requests. Wait {{seconds}} seconds, then retry.
errors.redirect: The host tried to redirect this request. Enter its final HTTPS address and reconnect.
errors.backend: The host could not complete this request ({{status}}). Check the host, then retry.
errors.file: The file could not be read or saved. Check available storage and choose the file again.
errors.keychain: The session could not be stored securely. Unlock this device and reconnect.
errors.choose_language: Choose at least one target language supported by the host engine.
errors.dub_failed: The dub stopped on the host. Check the host job details, then retry.
errors.audio: Audio could not start. Check microphone access and the audio device, then retry.
errors.dictation: Dictation stopped. Check the speech-to-text model and connection on your computer, then retry.
errors.translation: The host could not translate every segment. Check the translation engine and installed languages on the host, then retry.
errors.asr_missing: Install a speech-to-text model on your computer in VoiceStudio → Settings → Models / Dictation, then retry.
errors.upload_active: Wait for the current operation to finish or cancel the upload before switching servers.

android.request_failed: The server refused this request (HTTP {{code}}). Check the connection, server permissions and installed models, then try again.
android.invalid_response: The server returned an incomplete response. Update VoiceStudio on your computer and try again.
android.operation_failed: This action could not finish. Check the connection, permissions and available storage, then try again.
android.playback_failed: Playback failed. Check the connection and try Play again.
android.camera_failed: The camera could not start. Check camera permission in system Settings and scan again.
android.recording_failed: Recording failed. Check microphone permission and try again.
android.job_failed: The dub job stopped on the server. Check the host for model or media errors, then start again.
android.no_speech: The server found no speech. Choose a file with clear speech and start again.
android.translation_failed: Translation failed. Check the translation engine on your host, then start again.
android.languages_unavailable: Language choices are unavailable. Load an engine on your host, then refresh.
android.dictation_setup: Dictation is unavailable. On the host, install and accept an ASR model. For remote access, reconnect using an API key or a trusted network; a sharing PIN alone cannot authorize dictation.
android.analytics_local: This companion app records your choice on this phone. It sends no analytics.
android.model_licenses: Review model licenses on your host
android.disconnected_offline: Disconnected on this phone. The host could not confirm revocation; its session will expire automatically.
android.dub_restart: Dubbing could not start. Select the source and start again. If this keeps happening, reconnect to your VoiceStudio host.
android.dub_foreground_failed: Android could not start the background upload service. Reopen VoiceStudio and start the dub again. If it still fails, update or reinstall the app.

ios.licenses_app: VoiceStudio — GNU Affero General Public License v3.0
ios.licenses_host: View model license information on the paired host.
ios.notifications_permission: Allow local notifications for completed dubs.
ios.upload_pending: Upload continues in the background. Keep VoiceStudio on your computer running.
ios.upload_failed: Upload failed. Reconnect to the same host and select the media again.
ios.privacy_local: Analytics preference is saved on this device. This version never sends analytics.
ios.qr_unavailable: Camera is unavailable. Enter the host address manually.
ios.dub_resume_help: Reconnect to the original host to resume this job.
ios.delete_generation: Delete this generation? This can't be undone.

local.pair_settings: Connect a computer in Settings to use it.
local.inline_download: Download a model ({{size}}) to use this phone offline.
local.allow_mobile: Allow model downloads using mobile data
local.licence_confirm: I have the rights this licence requires for my use.
local.licensor_notice: VoiceStudio is not the model licensor and cannot grant rights. Review the declared licence and restrictions before accepting. Acceptance applies only to these exact terms.
local.licence_storage: Model licence records could not be read or saved. Free storage and try again; models remain blocked.
local.licence_required: Accept the licence in Models first.
local.ram_required: Needs {{ram}} GB of RAM. Pick a smaller model or use your computer.
local.wifi_required: Connect to Wi-Fi, or allow mobile data in Models.
local.storage_required: Not enough storage. Free some space and try again.
local.download_failed: The model download failed. Check your connection and resume in Models.
local.checksum_failed: Model verification failed. Delete this model and download it again.
local.model_required: Download this model in Models first.
local.model_incompatible: This model is missing a required runtime component. Update the catalogue or choose another model.
local.runtime_failed: A native runtime could not load. Reinstall the app for your device architecture.
local.inference_failed: On-device inference failed. Free memory or choose a smaller model and try again.
local.catalogue_failed: The bundled model catalogue could not be read. Update or reinstall the app.
local.capture_slow: This phone could not process microphone audio fast enough. Stop other apps or use your computer.
local.privacy: On-device tasks stay on this phone. Only model downloads, reports you choose to send and your paired computer use the network.
local.computer_feature: This feature currently runs on your computer. You can use Speech and Dictate on this phone without pairing.

consent.phone_note: Saved on this phone. Nothing is sent.

report.title: Report this result

reasons.impersonation: Impersonation or a voice cloned without consent

report.disclosure: Sends your reason, note, the app version and the model that made this to the VoiceStudio team. No audio, account or device ID is sent.
report.failed: Couldn't send the report. Check your connection and try again.
report.rate_limited: Too many reports from this network. Try again later.
report.invalid: This report couldn't be sent. Update the app and try again.

production.script_hint: Use # Chapter title for chapters and [voice:Name] at the start of a line to switch character. Plain text only; other markup is read aloud.
production.conversion_hint: Choose an audio clip up to 30 seconds. Conversion transcribes it and speaks it in the selected voice; it does not preserve the original performance.
